operations.name: Helen Woodson

expected.charges: Sabotage, destruction of government property, conspiracy and military-site trespass — November1984 Silo Pruning Hooks N5 missile-silo action.
expected.convicted: Convictions reported in United States v. Kabat,797F.2d580.
expected.sentence: Original sentence: consecutive nine-year terms on sabotage and property-destruction counts, concurrent six-month trespass term, and five years probation after unconditional release. Imposed sentence is not actual time served. November1984 MONTH precision: appellate narrative gives November9, but its later custody discussion and contemporary Nuclear Resister give November12. November9 is the earliest bound, not a verified exact day. Original sources establish arrest and continued detention; no release day or actual duration inferred. Sources: https://media.nukeresister.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/NR027_19841203small.pdf#page=2 ; https://law.justia.com/cases/federal/appellate-courts/F2/797/580/104857/

operations.name: Larry Medley

expected.charges: Assault and conspiracy allegations following the February 10, 1971 raid.
expected.convicted: Convicted of assault with a deadly weapon with intent to kill.
expected.sentence: Seven to ten years imposed; actual time served unverified.

updates.prosecutor: Robert Morgan; James E. Magner; Rolf F. Haskell (State counsel on appeal)
updates.sentence: Seven to ten years imposed; actual time served unverified. FBI monthly summary reports return to sentence custody in late January1973 after appeal bond; January1 is a month-only storage placeholder. Earlier pretrial detention is separate and is not counted as continuous from the 1971 arrest. Release date remains unresolved. State v. Jennings,192 S.E.2d46 (1972), affirmed October25,1972; appeal dismissed December5,1972. Sources: https://vault.fbi.gov/Black%20Panther%20Party%20/Black%20Panther%20Party%20Part%2034%20%28Final%29 ; https://law.justia.com/cases/north-carolina/court-of-appeals/1972/7218sc626-1.html
